title: The lab's parameters panel: the numbers behind the six verbs
question: Is this the right set of numbers to have your hands on -- and is there one you would reach for that is missing?
context_md:
You said: *"Give me the tools, data, access to necessary parameters that need to be tweaked and I do that testing myself in the game. That is the game."* This is the access half. **P**, or the PARAMS button on the tool row.

Four pages, mouse-driven: click a name to pick it, `-`/`+` to move it, the bar under each name shows how far along its range it sits, and every row explains itself on hover. **Nothing was tuned** -- every value in these shots is what ships today.

What I could not give you, and why:

- **Three plant rows are shown and not changeable** (LIGHT WEIGHT, BRANCH CHANCE, UPWARD WEIGHT). Each is four numbers, one per branch order -- a tree's is `0.15/0.30/0.50/0.60`. One row can only write one number, and writing it would flatten all four to the same value, which is a change to three things dressed up as a change to one.
- **SAVE writes 27 of the 42 rows back to their file.** The five plant growth rows it refuses because the same name appears twice in a species file -- once for the shoot, once for the root -- and it would edit the wrong one. GUT BIAS and BIRTH GRANT it refuses because they are half of a pair on one line. The seven BOX rows have no file at all; they are the spec a REBUILD is built from, and each says so.

The last two shots are the other half: click any living thing with LOOK and the cell page now carries **that individual's** own numbers under the cell's -- what generation it is, what it has set in seed, and for a plant the ten inherited multipliers that make two seeds of one species grow into different plants.

items.label: GROUND -- soil, packed soil, water
items.caption: Soil's dig resistance is 0.80 and an ant's dig force is 1.00; put one above the other and the colony stops tunnelling.

items.label: PLANT -- whichever the chip has armed
items.caption: Follows the species chip on the bar, so the page is always about the plant you are holding.

items.label: ANTS -- the colony species
items.caption: Dig force, hunger, what a birth costs, and how much a newborn's brain differs from its parent's.

items.label: BOX -- the lamps and the bed
items.caption: The lamp is live. The rest is what a REBUILD builds, and every row of it says so.

items.label: A plant, clicked
items.caption: Its own generation, what it has rooted and shot, and the ten multipliers it drew when it germinated.

items.label: An ant, clicked
items.caption: Its own diet and birth grant -- inherited, so not its species' -- and what it has in its jaws.
